data.description:
## Description

What: Extend provision-ruleset.sh with two boolean knobs, require_codeql and require_code_quality, that toggle the Require CodeQL and Require code-quality ruleset rules in the ruleset-write payload; both default to false on new projects. Why: Per the Knob Lifecycle Owner block, these knobs are the CONSUME path that turns the rules on/off per repo; the cross-repo CREATE owner is the /dso:onboarding security step which writes them to dso-config.conf and applies them. Scope IN: the two knobs, default-false behavior, payload wiring, and the onboarding-security-step ownership note in the script/docs. Scope OUT: actually enabling the rules on the DSO repo (draft-4), the CI jobs (draft-1/draft-2).


## Done Definitions

- provision-ruleset.sh accepts require_codeql and require_code_quality boolean knobs and, when each is true, includes the corresponding rule in the ruleset-write payload ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When both knobs are unset, provision-ruleset.sh defaults them to false and omits both rules from the payload ← Satisfies: sc-3
- An automated test exercises provision-ruleset.sh in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) asserting that knob=true emits the rule and unset defaults to false, and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Cross-repo ownership] Per the Knob Lifecycle Owner block, the /dso:onboarding security step is the CREATE owner that writes these knobs to dso-config.conf; do not duplicate ownership in this story — wire the consume path and reference onboarding.
- [Compatibility] Defaulting both knobs to false preserves existing provisioning behavior for projects that have not opted in.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator, I want require_codeql and require_code_quality knobs in provision-ruleset.sh, so that projects can opt in to the two scanning ruleset rules.
